questions: How many devices did you measure (the author contributions mention "devices"), how many cooldowns, and how many devices showed the 0.25 gate-period ratio at the even-denominator states?
Why were the other devices, and the developing states at ν = +1/2 and +5/2 marked in Fig. 1d, set aside?
Which ranges of ADG voltage, magnetic field and side-gate voltage did you measure at each filling beyond those in Fig. 2, and how did you pick the side-gate setting you call the weak-coupling regime?
What does the second-best dataset for each e/4 state look like, for example the same state at another field, side-gate setting or cooldown, with its extracted ΔV/ΔV1?
What is the sign of the stripe slope in Fig. 2a-d compared with the ν = −1 reference, and can you extract a charging energy from the DC-bias maps of the minimal-excitation data (Figs. S8c to S11c)?
How do the ratios in Fig. 4b change if you normalize with ν = −1 at 14 T (Fig. S3) in place of 10 T, and what antidot area do the field periods give at each even-denominator filling?
Did you repeat ADG sweeps at fixed field for the e/4 states, as in Fig. S13 for ν = 2/3, and did you check gate leakage at base temperature?

Could you reconcile a few cross-references: p. 6 assigns Fig. 3d,e to ν = 2/3 and Fig. 3g,i to ν = −1/2 while the caption assigns d-f to ν = −1/2 and g-i to ν = 2/3; p. 7 mentions ν = −2/3; and the e/4 suppression temperature reads about 60 mK (p. 8), 50 to 70 mK (p. 28) and 30 to 50 mK (p. 30)?
